steps.title: Safe cardinal
steps.rule: Everyone runs to the safe cardinal edge: the one with no primal in front of it.
steps.cue: Ultima and the primals take their places

steps.title: First dodge
steps.rule: Slide a few steps along the edge to the first safe spot, out of the Wheel and the dash line.
steps.cue: Wicked Wheel, Crimson Cyclone and Landslide

steps.title: Second dodge
steps.rule: Slide further along the edge to the second safe spot.

steps.title: Post dodges
steps.rule: Party groups north of centre; ranged and caster south; main tank a little further north.

MainTank.rule: Stand north of the party, slightly west.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand south of centre, apart from the melee.

CasterDps.rule: Stand south of centre, apart from the melee.

steps.title: Eruption bait 1
steps.rule: Physical ranged and caster bait the Eruptions from the south edge, each on their own side.

steps.title: Eruption bait 2
steps.rule: Baiters step outward along the south edge.

steps.title: Eruption bait 3
steps.rule: Baiters keep stepping around the edge toward east and west.

steps.title: Eruption bait 4
steps.rule: Baiters finish the arc toward the north.

steps.title: Stack north of centre
steps.rule: Everyone stacks north of centre for the raidwide.

steps.title: North edge for the Radiant Plumes
steps.rule: Stack at the north edge, where no plume lands.

steps.title: Dodge Titan's Landslide
steps.rule: Sidestep east along the north edge, out of the Landslide line.

steps.title: Back to the north edge
steps.rule: Return to the north edge stack.

steps.title: Party split
steps.rule: Party stacks north-west; the main tank stands apart to the north-east.

MainTank.rule: Stand apart from the party, north-east, for the tank hits.

steps.title: Split for Feather Rain
steps.rule: Both groups step in toward the centre, keeping the split, so the feathers land behind you.

steps.title: Back to the split
steps.rule: Back to the north-west stack and the main tank's north-east spot.
steps.cue: Homing Lasers on the main tank
